title: Mousai
tagline: Mousai is an NFT RoyaltyDAO that allows artists to share royalties with their fans.
description: Mousai allows music artists to share royalties with their fans ensuring regular royalties, strong community, and cuts out the middle man. This project puts music back in the hands of the people. Fans now can be emotionally and financially invested in their favorite artists. The contest allows for continued royalties. The artist can decides who receives a royalty, the percentage, and the amount of times the NFT can be resold.
